headline: Senior UI/UX Designer · Design Engineer
summary: Senior UI/UX designer and design engineer based in Riyadh, working in UI/UX and product design since 2017 across healthcare, B2B SaaS, AI, recruitment and education. Takes complex workflows — admin dashboards, role-based (RBAC) platforms, multi-step forms — from user flows, wireframing and Figma prototyping to production React, Next.js and TypeScript. Builds design systems and reusable component libraries (cut feature development time by 20% at Dycoders) and ships responsive, accessible (WCAG) interfaces; at OxCoders, improved Core Web Vitals by 45% with 90+ Lighthouse performance scores. Transferable Iqama; available to join immediately.
